about: Chess piece sets for Zeist Chess, as data, so the iOS app, the web and the main Zeist app offer the same sets. Sets differ in shape only: every set is drawn in Zeist's ivory and ebony (tokens: piece), lit the same way. The iOS app renders them with ios/scripts/pieces.py from ios/art/pieces-<id>/, whose README quotes each license. license is an SPDX identifier.
